Author: Dalagab Group
Name: Omega
Punchline: A curated, searchable marketplace for Dalamud plugins.
Description: Omega by the Dalagab Group is a visual Dalamud plugin marketplace with a preferred hash-checked downloadable catalog database, automatic local-source fallback, repository and author filters, stale-repository suppression, API compatibility badges, explicit duplicate-source choice, and installation delegated to Dalamud.
